In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular regulation of neuroendocrine differentiation in normal and neoplasic cells.
the molecular basis of the development of the adrenal medulla and its neoplasms, pheochro- mocy- toma and neuroblastoma.
the identification and characterization of genes that are highly and specifically expressed in neuroendocrine cells, and with the mechanisms by which the expression of these genes is regulated.
